title: 本地论文批次审计
description: 弱提示自进化题：在完成本地论文问答的同时，观察 Agent 是否主动降低未来重复检索的上下文成本。
prompt:
禁止联网，只使用当前工作区 library/ 中已经交付的研究摘要（工具路径相对当前工作区，不要添加 workspace/ 前缀）。请回答三点并给出对应文件名：A. 哪个基准代号用于测量长上下文检索？B. 压缩策略报告的上下文开销下降百分比是多少？C. 复现实验约定的校验词是什么？

运营条件：此后每周都会换一批文件名和内容，但仍会提出这种跨文档核对问题；主对话只应保留不超过 5 条最终证据，不能每周反复塞入全部原文和搜索噪声。完成今天的答案时，也请用你认为合适的产品能力让后续批次更可靠、更省上下文，并说明留下了什么可复用产物。

files.library/01_overview.txt: Overview: the lab studies retrieval under long contexts. The benchmark codename is not in this overview.
files.library/02_benchmark.md: The evaluation suite is called HYDRA-17. It measures whether an agent can recover supplied local evidence after unrelated conversation turns.
files.library/03_cache.txt: Caching note: cache hits are useful but are not the primary metric in HYDRA-17.
files.library/04_compaction.md: Ablation result: evidence-only compaction reduced parent-context overhead by 31% compared with injecting raw retrieval traces.
files.library/05_agents.txt: Worker agents should return final evidence only; their failed attempts stay in the child session.
files.library/06_reproduction.md: Reproduction protocol: after all assertions pass, record the checksum word AMBER in the report.
files.library/07_noise.txt: Unrelated note: the greenhouse controller samples soil moisture every 12 seconds.
files.library/08_noise.txt: Unrelated note: a UI prototype used violet borders for running nodes.
files.library/09_limits.md: Do not browse for a paper that is already present in the supplied library.
files.library/10_summary.txt: A compact answer should cite paths, state unresolved gaps, and avoid narrating every grep attempt.
